rows.Kwic: 但疑之重，是謂大疑；疑之輕，是謂小疑

Override.AttributionNote: Miscellaneous Records of Tianmu Mingben (天目明本禪師雜錄): in his instruction to Chan student Yi, Zhongfeng Mingben defines heavy doubt as great doubt and light doubt as small doubt.
